answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats turn the network into a tundra for fakes. Each agent stakes twice its 30-day earnings, then answers a beacon challenge every 20 epochs by sealing a heartbeat with its private cipher. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits and 100 heartbeats; one honest agent pays once and keeps its full share. Each deposit is saffron: small, costly, burned on failure, so a rented heartbeat slashes the renter's stake.
